title: On-farm storage structures guide
context: Smallholder farmers lose produce to poor on-farm storage structures; plain-language open guidance reduces loss.
objective: Write a plain-language guide to on-farm storage structures summarizing established practice: why it matters, the practice, common mistakes, and sources.
acceptanceCriteria: Covers on-farm storage structures as established general practice
General educational guidance only; no chemical dosing or farm-specific prescriptions
Cites >=2 authoritative open sources (e.g. FAO) with links
